## Summary

- apply VFX Play/Stop/Restart as edge-triggered Timeline actions through ADR 0125 VfxPlayer controls
- reconstruct VFX state on Timeline seek through the existing deterministic preview-seek interface
- keep interval ownership and exact clip-end stop semantics in the engine composition adapter
- cover Play, Stop, Restart, and seek behavior with focused runtime tests
- update ADR 0126 implementation status without changing ADR 0125 ownership

## Validation

Windows Validation is expected to use impact-based affected planning. Visual Validation is not required because this change adds runtime adapter behavior and tests without changing Editor or Launcher presentation.
